positions.title: DevOps Engineer
description: Took the k3s and monitoring setup I built as an intern and rolled it out to more production servers and project environments.
Handle infrastructure and deployments for Gujarat Government projects, which have strict uptime and performance requirements.
Built CI/CD pipelines for production that cut build, test and deploy time.

positions.title: DevOps Intern
description: Moved staging servers from Apache and Tomcat to k3s, and swapped Prometheus for VictoriaMetrics and Loki so monitoring fit on low-resource machines.
Moved 25 engineers from Jira and Bitbucket to GitHub Teams, with project management handled through GitHub Actions. Tooling went from $300 to $100 a month (67% less).
Built CI/CD pipelines for 80+ apps (React, Java, Python). Releases went from every two weeks to 2–3 a day, and most pipelines finish in under 2 minutes.
Replaced a shared all-access database user with a version-controlled DB pipeline, so every schema change is logged.
Centralized the staging databases and set up redundant MySQL and PostgreSQL instances so dev work kept going during the migration.
